summary: Mouse, rat and dog IV/PO population PK with allometry; predicts human IV disposition and repeated oral profiles. The integrated model also uses Phase 1A clinical observations.
validation: Phase 1B profiles provide a later comparison, but this is not a fully human-PK-free development workflow. Human-data contributions must be separated before adapting it to the current holdout design.
data_availability: Open article link and primary abstract; raw data and model files not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
